template: Limit on upfront charges at or before start of tenancy, including charges by lessor's agent applies to this address. Source: M.G.L. c. 186, § 15B(1)(b), as amended by St. 2025, c. 9, §§ 54-55; as of 2026-01-02. Not legal advice.
rewrite: This address is covered by a limit on upfront charges at or before the start of a tenancy, including charges by the landlord's agent. Source: M.G.L. c. 186, § 15B(1)(b), as amended by St. 2025, c. 9, §§ 54-55; as of 2026-01-02. Not legal advice.
